facts.fact: 她在家等着论功，等的是一句承认。
facts.anchor: Kiamling waited for the accolades.

facts.fact: 结果门口既没有敲门声，也没有请帖。
facts.anchor: Neither knocks nor invitations appeared at her door.

facts.fact: 连平日请她办猎妖活的委托也断了。
facts.anchor: Not even the usual requests for her yiugwai-hunting services.

facts.fact: 钱剑上的铜钱铸的不是面值，而是一枚枚锤打出法力文字。
facts.anchor: Rather than being inscribed with characters denoting their worth, each coin had been individually struck with a hammer to stamp words of power on their surface.

facts.fact: 剑柄上的穗子是妹妹编的护身符。
facts.anchor: Jingling had made the tassel, a good-luck charm with wide knotted loops tied to the hilt.

facts.fact: 她拉开门，正撞上 Hoi 举在额前、差一秒就敲下去的手。
facts.anchor: Yanking the door open, she was faced with Hoi’s fist at the level of her forehead, a second away from knocking.

facts.fact: Hoi 打趣她身上的味道能挡僵尸、也能挡客人。
facts.anchor: “About as long as it’s been since you last washed. An effective ward against geongsi, I suppose. Customers too.”

facts.fact: Hoi 说自己是来看看她是否平安的。
facts.anchor: “Believe it or not, I came to check if you were okay.

facts.fact: 官方给的说法是黄热病加奇怪的幻觉。
facts.anchor: “That’s the official story the British are telling. Yellow fever and strange hallucinations.

facts.fact: 看台倒塌被推给施工质量差。
facts.anchor: The collapse of the grandstand is being blamed on poor workmanship.

facts.fact: 她没等 Hoi 把话说完就运起气跑开。
facts.anchor: Kiamling didn’t give him a chance to finish.

facts.fact: 干货店在火里受损的 Soon 先生当街叫住她。
facts.anchor: “You!” shouted a vicious voice. It was Mr Soon, whose dried-food store had been partially damaged in the fire.

facts.fact: Soon 骂她沾手就坏、是被诅咒的，女人做猎妖人根本不成。
facts.anchor: “Everything you touch turns bad. You are cursed! Women yiugwai hunters? Pah, we all knew it wouldn’t work.

facts.fact: 他还诬她因嫉妒而害死祖母。
facts.anchor: “Did you murder your grandmother as well? We all know you were jealous of her.”

facts.fact: 那天她第二次跑开。
facts.anchor: For the second time that day, Kiamling ran.

facts.fact: 她定下念头：去找妹妹。
facts.anchor: She knew what she needed to do. Find Jingling.

facts.fact: Archie 右臂吊着绷带来迎她。
facts.anchor: He turned to greet her, his right arm in a sling.

facts.fact: Archie 说自己头也撞了，混乱中昏过去，什么都没看见。
facts.anchor: “I’m afraid I also hit my head. Knocked out cold for the stampede and everything that ensued.

facts.fact: 她纠正他：她叫 Kiam Ling，意思是剑魂。
facts.anchor: “My name is not Kim, it’s Kiamling. Kiam Ling. It means Sword Spirit.

facts.fact: 他讲这道门叫 lychgate，乡下人抬死者走很远的路去教堂。
facts.anchor: “A lychgate. Back home in the country, people carried their dead miles upon miles to the nearest church for burial.

facts.fact: 她回家时前门虚掩着。
facts.anchor: The front door was ajar.

facts.fact: 茶楼帮工 Keilin 举着妹妹给的钥匙，正在屋里替妹妹收衣服。
facts.anchor: “Jing-Jing gave me her key!” Keilin said, holding the evidence up as her eyes widened.

facts.fact: 她这才迟迟明白妹妹和 Keilin 那些相处是调情。
facts.anchor: That, she very belatedly realised, was flirting.

facts.fact: 章末她得知妹妹在娱乐区、在妓院做工。
facts.anchor: Her precious little sister, the darling of the Au family, was working in the entertainment district. At a brothel.
